title: Caacay kee girah amoytiinu
intro: Tasaawir dominion silayti isih inki miraacah gacsa abeeh, qunxa-qunxa ginook xongoloola qilsa elle quukak sugteeh, qaadik tan intit able wayta caylitte cubbi luk taamitak sugte. ta muuci qaadik yan amoytiinul kicna naharal, cayla liyyittel kee jinnil yabbixe. Laakin kaxxa abbobti kaxxa aqayyaare luk temeete — kee ellecaboh uddur, mano kee rabi isih elle yan innal, sissin caagiida wagsiisak, sissin caagiida wagsiisak, sissin caagiida wagsiisak, sissin qaynatih taqabitte wagsiisak, sissin qaynatih taqabitte wagsiisak, sissin qaynatih taqabitte wagsiisak, sissin qaynatih taqabitte wagsiisak, sissin qaynatih taqabitte wagsiisak.
clues: Anu kaxxa amoytiinih naggaareh kiciyyo xaleenak usuk kaadu yallih nabiyyi kee taama abeyna.
Yalli silaytut reeda yoh yeceeh, inki maaca alsi gexoh farmo ruube.
walaa qunxa gineenit yabtam yi xayyos, kee anu sooliseyyo ken hangisso cakkumsutuh.
Anu amriseh fidin qande jinni, sahda kee kimbir, inkih massowteh caddot yok foocal.
baxxo le mirac yoo gibbatuh yemeete gibdi gexkalit luk, kee anu too miraaciini qarkayto yi cokmih buxal baahe gufneh yemeete num daffeynak ugtaamak naharal.
Anu sooleh suge, staff lih qimbbiseh, ardi bagul qunxa gino qimbbiseh suge — kee tokkel dubuk yi dariifal yan mari anu tatreh sugem tamixxige.

arabic: وَلِسُلَيْمَـٰنَ ٱلرِّيحَ عَاصِفَةًۭ تَجْرِى بِأَمْرِهِۦٓ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلَّتِى بَـٰرَكْنَا فِيهَا ۚ وَكُنَّا بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَـٰلِمِينَ
verse: And to Solomon [We subjected] the wind, blowing forcefully, proceeding by his command toward the land which We had blessed. And We are ever, of all things, Knowing. (21:81)
